name: Ersveil rules
author: Story Suite examples
description: Calendar, coins, guild ranks, names and trackers for Ersveil

weather: short hot spell, haze on the horizon
crisp and clear, first frost at dawn
grey sky, leaves driving on the wind
freezing fog, ice on the roads

skillSets.name: Sealwarden recruit
skillSets.about: Sworn to the Order of the Sealwardens for a year: a month at the upper seals, then the gates of the Auvoth Depths.

skills.name: Gate spear
skills.about: Holding a gate or a stair with a long spear, shoulder to shoulder, against what comes up.

skills.name: Ward-reading
skills.about: Reading the seals and wards on a door, and feeling when one strains.

skills.name: Lamp-keeping
skills.about: Keeping the never-out lamps burning through bad air, smoke, cold and long watches.

skills.name: Breach drill
skills.about: Falling back in order through a gate before a swarm, and closing it behind the last.

skills.name: Gate challenge
skills.about: Stopping parties at the descents, reading permits and spotting forged badges.

deed.refusal: Deeds need witnesses: a deed nobody lived to tell earns no fame. Write witnessed: true only when someone saw it.

spread.refusal: News spreads from one region to another; name two different regions.

register.refusal: Already registered: everyone registers once and starts at F.

dues.refusal: Register at a Guild hall first.

contract.refusal: Only a registered member works Guild contracts.

promote.refusal: Register first; a promotion names a new letter.

yearend.refusal: The Guild year only turns for a registered member.
